objective: Requalify the sources as an axis, on the arrangement of the second design round's Instrument proposal: a bank of seven apertures under the header, each stating what it holds and how many rows it carries.

the_decisions.the_arrangement: the Instrument's faceplate: full-width bands read from the top down. This slice builds the first of them — the source bank — and the state the rest of the bands will read from.
the_decisions.the_two_families: a source is either a store (a package manager the user goes to: ALPM, AUR, Flatpak, Cargo, NPM) or an installation method (a single file that arrives on its own: AppImage, tracked releases). The stores come first, the methods last and grouped.
the_decisions.the_reasons: the absence of an action expresses a limit, and the reason lives in the source's own entry: a source the engine does not manage has no command, a source that holds no dependencies has nothing to show.
the_decisions.the_also_in: a name is not a package: the card says where else the name is found, with the versions.

what_changed.state: a new module, state/sources.rs: the family of a source, what it holds, its limits and their reasons, the counts by source, the axis the control presents, and the 'also in'.
what_changed.surface: a new component, components/source_bank.rs: seven apertures, each with the name, the kind, the count, the health and the retry, reachable by the keyboard.
what_changed.card: the inspector's overview carries an ALSO IN band; the action row states the reason of an absent action.
what_changed.control: the filters menu's source entries carry the note and the count, and the old SourceEntry/ecosystems_for are gone: the axis is the one list of the sources.
what_changed.order: PackageSourceKind::ALL and NavScope::sources() put the stores before the installation methods.

the_proof.tests: 221 passed (the floor is 195): seven new ones in state/sources.rs, covering the families, the notes, the limits, the counts, the axis, and the 'also in'.
the_proof.the_gaps: the nameplate (A9), the tape (A10) and the dial (A11) are not built; the menu still offers the sources as the narrow fallback (A8). The acceptance matrix says so, line by line.
